Community conversation this week centered on **Hermes Agent**, driven by founder **@Teknium** and the official **NousResearch** account.

**Product advocacy & roadmap:** The defining thread was **@Teknium**'s [forceful defense of **Hermes Agent** against maintenance complaints](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-b976389fa4ad) (859 likes, 26k views), touting accrued skill XP and a $50k/month Hermes-based effort, plus [enumerated competitive differentiators](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-f5189845cc2f) (no automatic repo uploads, provider choice, large plugin ecosystem). He also [committed to a concrete one-month roadmap](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-b2c158a702f8) — computers with every subscription, a mobile app, and web GUI access — and [confirmed a stable release channel has existed for nearly a month](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-77f6ffa80704). Official messaging reinforced the control/flexibility positioning (['Hermes Agent gives you control'](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-700ffb0d6b2a) at 74k views; ['use any model you want'](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-283aa09efa8c); ['Make Hermes do it'](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-4ac01487cfd5)), alongside an [open-source-values statement](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-bb9f737db32a) ('your data isn't yours unless it's open source') and a [cryptic 'it's coming' teaser](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-ccce8577ffa2) that drew strong engagement.

**Open-source tooling spotlight:** The standout community release was **@rlaope**'s [**Oh-My-Hermes**](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-85a24234b6f2) — a Hermes Agent configuration tuned over 200B tokens and open-sourced as a one-line install bundling 150+ skills, a memory system, subagent routing, and parallel tool calling (~1.4k likes, 108 reposts). Its [companion coding-skills package](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-6938307e3f10) reached 3.6k GitHub stars, and rlaope [provided technically detailed support](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-196e2dccee67) (clarifying that OMH's menu configures model routing rather than installing or running local models).

**Feature education & real-world use:** **@Teknium** published an [official overview of the **Curator** component](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-6753097d407c) and a [gateway thread for going deeper with Hermes Agent](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-17236af5095a). A [first-party demo](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-b401d170775a) showed Hermes sending **Telegram** pings while a Claude-backed agent kept working overnight — the community's favorite hands-off-autonomy anecdote. A smaller report claimed [**Kimi K3.1 Pro** one-shot a task through oh-my-hermes](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-a7c6b9849421), hinting at model-agnostic synergy.

**Team & ecosystem growth:** Teknium [welcomed a new **Hermes Agent** crew member](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-49673565031e), [publicly invited **@amorriscode** and **@just_cameron** to build the desktop app](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-11189885fb24), and [pointed candidates to the Nous Research careers page](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-842282c77dd8) — signaling active hiring and investment. Practical availability notes ([free tier stocked with models](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-52ac117d2f4d), [TestFlight + Android beta](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-4ddc5b4f1188)) rounded out the week.

**Sentiment:** Broadly enthusiastic and loyal, with product-philosophy debates ([opt-in defaults](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-33d6a47bd995), [sovereignty, transparency, self-improvement](/?date=2026-10-25&category=social#item-65b0f53c395e)) engaged openly and specifically by the founder rather than deflected. Editorial note: the roadmap post was elevated into the top 10 over a lower-substance team-welcome post for newsletter value; the excluded DeepSeek item concerned a model released ~44 days before coverage, so it was omitted as stale.

Meet Oh-My-Hermes 

I burned 200B tokens tuning my Hermes Agent setup, and now you can get all of it with a one-line install.

It comes with 150+ skills, a long-term memory system that lasts twice as long, graph engineering, and memory-management skills. It also includes subagent routing across model chains, plus optimizations like parallel tool calling and evals.

You don't need to do much, though. Just install it and give it a task. Everything is optimized to route automatically. Hermes Agent is excellent, and I love this technology.

I put a lot into making it really good, then open-sourced it so you can enjoy it right away. Meet oh-my-hermes.

items.title: @BrianReborn_alt That menu configures OMH’s model routing—it doesn’t install or start the listed mod...
items.content:
@BrianReborn_alt That menu configures OMH’s model routing—it doesn’t install or start the listed models. It sets which models to request for different tasks, rather than downloading model weights or launching a local inference engine.

OMH runs on top of Hermes, so Hermes still needs a working model provider/account or a separately configured local inference server. Having Hermes installed in Termux doesn’t, by itself, mean those models are available locally.

The setup screen should make that distinction clearer, especially when it presents a list of models without showing which ones are actually connected and usable.

Does your existing Hermes installation already respond to a normal chat message? That would ▉

items.title: I made a 4-hour fan game with AI and gave it as a gift to my favorite streamer, who has 500K subscri...
items.content:
I made a 4-hour fan game with AI and gave it as a gift to my favorite streamer, who has 500K subscribers.

His playthrough video got 300K views on YouTube, and his reaction brought tears to his eyes.

I rebuilt the whole story around DELTARUNE and the characters from his stream.

For the art, assets, cutscene staging and sound, I took DELTARUNE (@tobyfox) as the reference, toned it down and made new versions.

I'm really happy that he enjoyed playing it so much and that it got such a great response.

You can watch the YouTube video of the game here.
https://t.co/a62HkAGpIW

#game #fanmade
